title: A proper formal system algebraizes after projective modification
statement: Let $A,I,f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ satisfy Noetherianness, I-adic completeness and properness [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring, def-weil-proper-morphism], and assume X Noetherian. Put $J=I\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal]. For every $M\in\mathit{Coh}(X,J)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], there exist a scheme Y, a proper map $q:Y\to X$, a dense open $U\subset X$ on which q is an isomorphism, and a coherent module F on Y [pqf-def-coherent], such that the ambient inverse system $M\circ q^*$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is isomorphic to $(F/(J\mathcal O_Y)^{n+1}F)_n$. Only the system on Y is algebraized.

source.place: Proposition 30.25.4 (088C), last paragraph: Chow modification, formal pullback and projective algebraization, before pushforward

proof.text: Use the constructed Chow modification q, proper and surjective and isomorphic over a dense open U. Since f is proper, the library instance makes its immersion into finite-index projective space closed. The composite q followed by f supplies Noetherianness of Y.

Use ProjectiveSpace.exists_isClosedImmersion_finite_coordinates to close-embed the finite-index projective space into a standard ULift(Fin(n+1)) projective space over Spec A. Compose with the Chow embedding; its projection is q followed by f. Apply projective existence and ideal comap composition to get equivalence for completion on Y at J.comap q.

Formal-systems pullback supplies P with its specified inclusion equation. Choose F as the object preimage of P(M) under the completion equivalence. This object is determined up to isomorphism by full faithfulness. Apply the formal-category inclusion to the inverse preimage isomorphism, and transport its source along the object equality obtained by evaluating the inclusion equation. Return F and this ambient-system isomorphism with q and U.

mathlib_searches.query: Failure of algebraization of coherent formal modules on a proper scheme reduces to a maximal closed subscheme with every nonzero closed quotient algebraizable
mathlib_searches.results: Eight results: affine transition limits, finite morphisms, integral schemes, and a properness criterion over a field. None gives this algebraization reduction.

Library search found full faithfulness, devissage, projective existence, formal pullback, push-pull and the proved ProjectiveSpace.exists_isClosedImmersion_finite_coordinates. No maximal algebraization counterexample theorem or direct proper-existence proof. The 088E Chow comparison has a different conclusion about proper support, and is not applicable on an already proper scheme.

lean.statement: theorem proper_existence_projective_pullback (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) [IsProper f] (M : CoherentFormalModule X ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).ker.comap f)) : let J := (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).ker.comap f ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ X) (_ : IsProper q) (U : X.Opens), Dense (U : Set X) ∧ IsIso (q ∣_ U) ∧ ∃ F : CoherentModules Y, Nonempty (M.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q ≅ formalCompletionSystem (J.comap q) F.obj)
